settings.heading: ONE VISION. MANY HANDS ALONG THE WAY.
settings.text:
Rizo is founder-led, but the world has never moved alone. Friends, models, event help, supporters, and people who believed early helped carry it outside.

No inflated titles. No pretending a growing circle is a corporate team. Just real people showing up while the world takes shape.
settings.shoutout: SHOUT OUT TO EVERY PERSON WHO MODELED, HELPED AT A TABLE, CARRIED PIECES, TOOK A PHOTO, GAVE FEEDBACK, OR SHOWED UP BEFORE THERE WAS A TITLE FOR IT.
